title: Kiosk KYC attestation
description: The decoded JWS payload of a KYC attestation, the POST /kiosk/agents/kyc request body, the request_kyc answer, the body that the KYC provider posts to the callback and its answer, and the data of the kyc_verification event that delivers the attestation.

attestation.description: Signed by the KYC provider, verified with its configured public key.

level.description: Binary; anything other than "verified" is rejected.

iss.description: MUST equal the provider-configured KYC issuer.

aud.description: OPERATOR-BINDING. The operator the attestation was minted for. MUST equal the audience the operator's KYC provider mints for it (its origin, or a stable handle it registered); the operator rejects any other aud. This stops a claim minted for operator A being replayed to operator B.

iat.description: Issued-at timestamp. Not enforced by the verifier.

exp.description: One year after iat. An expired attestation is rejected.

attributes.description: Optional named boolean attributes that the KYC provider vouches for, e.g. age_over_18. Only a value that is literally true counts; an action MAY require named attributes and refuse with kyc_required (403).

kyc_jws.description: The attestation as a compact EdDSA JWS.

verification.description: The answer to the request_kyc action: a verification opened at the KYC provider, whose page the AI assistant relays to its human.

request_id.description: The provider's id for this verification; the kyc_verification event carries it back.

verification_url.description: The provider page the human completes.

callback.description: The body that the KYC provider posts to POST <endpoint>/kyc/callback when the human approves (Section 12.4.1). The operator answers 403 unless nonce equals the one that it kept.

request_id.description: The provider's id for the verification that request_kyc opened.

nonce.description: The one-time nonce that the provider gave the operator when it opened the verification.

kyc_jws.description: The attestation as a compact EdDSA JWS.

callbackAnswer.description: The operator's 200 answer to a callback that it accepted.

verificationEvent.description: The data of a kyc_verification event: the human approved, and the event carries the provider-signed attestation to submit to POST /kiosk/agents/kyc.

kyc_jws.description: The attestation as a compact EdDSA JWS.
